stabilization-v1.current_surface: Abstract executive briefing, visible metrics, actor/process/decision rows, immutable history/replay, and debrief text.
stabilization-v1.written_equivalent: Current briefing, metric, process, decision, history, replay, and debrief fields remain text-complete without a map or facility illustration.
reopen_triggers: Facility placement changes a visible decision or consequence.
A map or facility view becomes necessary to explain a stabilization causal chain.

regional-affiliation-v1.current_surface: Stage, partner, commitment, review, integration, immutable history/replay, and debrief text through the shared campaign contract.
regional-affiliation-v1.written_equivalent: Current stage, partner, commitment, review, integration, replay, and debrief fields remain text-complete without a map or facility illustration.
reopen_triggers: Affiliation geography or facility relationships become actor-visible.
Facility placement changes a visible partner, review, or integration consequence.
A map or facility view becomes necessary to explain a regional affiliation causal chain.

limits: This decision does not establish asset placement/use, visual quality, screenshot coverage, device/browser compatibility, or human review.
The generic-facility descriptor is a fallback boundary, not evidence that future campaign art will never be needed.
No new map, facility, portrait, stage-art, raster, audio, registry, or runtime asset is created or promoted.
No instructor-only true-state view, counterfactual, distributional visualization, persistence, or public-release claim is made.
evidence: Both current campaign surfaces are represented by the typed campaign-coverage inventory.
Both campaigns have an explicit current need decision, fallback descriptor, written equivalent, and reopen triggers.
The decision is consistent with the existing reusable-asset matrix and generic-facility fallback test.
